notes.title: Horror about accepting your mistakes.
notes.content:
[b]SFUMATO is a 2D psychological horror game where Justian has to escape from the nightmare of the city. The game is about accepting your mistakes, anger, madness and discovery.[/b]

[previewyoutube=ipRWkAIV-LY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630029/aa4676de1120009660a3a50745a338a846f95ed2.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]STORY[/b][/h2]
Justian wakes up after a nightmare and notices the sketches are missing. He can't leave his apartment. The city is drowning in fog. Your journey becomes a nightmare. Accepting your mistakes is the only way out ...

Justian loves to paint, but his problems in life, just keep him down. He wants to become a famous artist to earn money to live and become free. Those close to him support him in his endeavors. But...

[h3][i]Developer's words: [/i][/h3]
[i]I rejected the psychological problems of the hero and wrote a story that can happen to anyone. A man who chose the wrong path, and this path led him to serious consequences. Some locations in the game are rewritten dreams from a diary. During development, I started spending a lot of time dreaming and writing them down in my diary.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630029/e74377631295220c0e534b0c096169a4607faca7.png[/img]

[h2][b]The world of SFUMATO is between the real and the fictional.[/b][/h2]

At night, Justian begins sketching anger-filled sketches. He loses consciousness and finds himself in a completely different world. Ordinary things begin to distort and reveal themselves from other sides. His apartment has become a space between reality and madness.

After a nightmare, Justian notices the blank canvases next to which a path leading to another room. Outside the window there is a thick fog where a small ray of sunshine can be seen. The keys to the apartment, are missing and the door won't unlock. It remains only to follow the black trail.....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630029/1ae895e99fb28dd57c966ce585e9e5a957f161a1.png[/img]

[h3][i]Developer's words: [/i][/h3]
[i]The story of SFUMATO is my personal life story in which I will find what I am going after. If you're doing something you don't like. You should consider throwing off your chains.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630029/7523c57ca45aeb75e6ac2a9add3254438c10d608.png[/img]

[b]I really hope that my game, you will enjoy and give an unusual experience. I am waiting for your click on the button - “add to wishlist”. [/b]
